TWO BROTHERS · TWO PLAYERS · ONE SPLIT · ONE MISSION

slides.title: Stefan's pitch
slides.body:
One mission. Consequences that reach the other player.
The line that opens Stefan's pitch. Everything in this deck is built to keep that promise.

slides.title: The question
slides.body:
What structure can hold all of this for two players?
A shared story, choices with real consequences, and two friends playing it together.

slides.title: A video game architecture
slides.body:
The foundation
Two players live unique, separate experiences inside the same storyline. Each player's decisions change the world the other plays in.

slides.title: Fight beside the brothers
slides.body:
The foundation
The players fight beside the brothers.
Each player is a teammate. The brothers are characters the game controls, the way Ellie is in The Last of Us. Over time, players learn them and change them.

slides.title: What sits on the foundation
slides.body:
Next layers
01 · FOUNDATION — SET
The architecture
Two separate experiences in one storyline, with decisions that change each other's world.
02 · MECHANICS — ITERATING
Comms · Messages · Tempo · Combat
Ways to create the experience. Combat: likely gun-heavy, still open.
03 · STORY & WORLD — THE PAINTING
Brutal, post-apocalyptic, dark
Violent and gory. The commander, The Child and the regime are still being painted.
04 · EMOTIONAL EXPERIENCE
Stress & trauma
Felt, not managed, as players learn the world and the brothers.

slides.title: How comms works
slides.body:
Mechanic // Comms
01 · TOGETHER
Open voice
While the team is together, players talk over their mics, like Friday the 13th.
02 · THE SPLIT
Voice cuts off
Once the teams separate, the voice link between the players goes dark.
03 · APART
Message birds
From then on, a message bird is the only way to reach the other team.

slides.title: Message birds
slides.body:
Mechanic // Messages
At moments in the journey, a bird can carry a message to the other team. It's the only way through.

slides.title: A message can lie
slides.body:
Messages // Potential feature
A message can lie.
If a player and their brother start pursuing a different cause, a message can be sent to deceive the other team.

slides.title: Two tempos
slides.body:
RIPPLES
Mechanic // Tempo
Two tempos that bounce together
Each pair keeps its own pace. Ripples bounce between them; at times the paths overlap.

slides.title: The full loop
slides.body:
Foundation + mechanics
The full loop: together, the split, choices, ripples, messages, and drift toward conflict.

slides.title: Stress & trauma
slides.body:
Emotional experience
Stress & trauma is something the player feels.
Not a meter to manage. Choice moments let players experience what someone at war with PTSD would, as they learn more about the world they're in and the brothers they're with.

slides.title: The painting
slides.body:
Story & world
The story and the world are what gets painted on the foundation. Still being painted: the commander, The Child, the regime, a fractured America.
